description: This file provides implementations for handling array data structures and associated data types (string, integer, array) in the lighttpd web server project, including functions for copying, inserting, freeing, and searching within arrays.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ data_unset * array_data_string_copy(const data_unset * s)
methods.description: Copies a data_string object, including key and value buffers.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ void array_data_string_insert_dup(data_unset * dst,data_unset * src)
methods.description: Inserts duplicate of a data_string into another, concatenating values if needed.

methods.name: void array_data_string_free(data_unset * du)
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a data_string object.

methods.name: __attribute_noinline__ data_string * array_data_string_init(void)
methods.description: Initializes a new data_string object with appropriate method pointers.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ data_unset * array_data_integer_copy(const data_unset * s)
methods.description: Copies a data_integer object, including key and value.

methods.name: void array_data_integer_free(data_unset * du)
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a data_integer object.

methods.name: __attribute_noinline__ data_integer * array_data_integer_init(void)
methods.description: Initializes a new data_integer object with methods.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ data_unset * array_data_array_copy(const data_unset * s)
methods.description: Copies a data_array object, including key and nested array.

methods.name: void array_data_array_free(data_unset * du)
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a data_array object.

methods.name: __attribute_noinline__ data_array * array_data_array_init(void)
methods.description: Initializes a new data_array object with method pointers.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ void array_extend(array * const a,uint32_t n)
methods.description: Extends the array's capacity by a specified number of elements.

methods.name: array * array_init(uint32_t n)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new array with an optional initial capacity.

methods.name: void array_free_data(array * const a)
methods.description: Frees the data within an array, including all elements.

methods.name: void array_copy_array(array * const dst,const array * const src)
methods.description: Copies the contents from a source array to a destination array.

methods.name: void array_free(array * const a)
methods.description: Frees the entire array structure and its data.

methods.name: void array_reset_data_strings(array * const a)
methods.description: Resets the key and value buffers of string data entries within the array.

methods.name: data_unset * array_get_element_klen_ext(const array * const a,const int ext,const char * key,const uint32_t klen)
methods.description: Retrieves an element by key with extension handling, inserting if missing.

methods.name: __attribute_hot__ __attribute_pure__ int32_t array_get_index_ext(const array * const a,const int ext,const char * const k,const uint32_t klen)
methods.description: Finds the index of a key with extension comparison; returns negative if not found.

methods.name: __attribute_hot__ const data_unset * array_get_element_klen(const array * const a,const char * key,const uint32_t klen)
methods.description: Retrieves an element by key and length.

methods.name: data_unset * array_get_data_unset(const array * const a,const char * key,const uint32_t klen)
methods.description: Retrieves data associated with a key without modifying array.

methods.name: data_unset * array_extract_element_klen(array * const a,const char * key,const uint32_t klen)
methods.description: Removes and returns an element by key, adjusting sorted array accordingly.

methods.name: data_unset * array_get_unused_element(array * const a,const data_type_t t)
methods.description: Returns an unused data element of a specific type if available for reuse.

methods.name: __attribute_hot__ data_unset * array_insert_data_at_pos(array * const a,data_unset * const entry,const uint_fast32_t pos)
methods.description: Inserts a data_unset entry at a specified position, maintaining sorted order.

methods.name: data_integer * array_insert_integer_at_pos(array * const a,const uint_fast32_t pos)
methods.description: Inserts an integer data element at a position, creating new if none available.

methods.name: __attribute_hot__ data_string * array_insert_string_at_pos(array * const a,const uint_fast32_t pos)
methods.description: Inserts a string data element at a position.

methods.name: __attribute_hot__ buffer * array_get_buf_ptr_ext(array * const a,const int ext,const char * const k,const uint32_t klen)
methods.description: Gets buffer pointer for a key, inserting if absent, with extension handling.

methods.name: int * array_get_int_ptr(array * const a,const char * const k,const uint32_t klen)
methods.description: Gets pointer to integer value for a key, inserting if absent.

methods.name: buffer * array_get_buf_ptr(array * const a,const char * const k,const uint32_t klen)
methods.description: Gets buffer pointer for a key, inserting if absent.

methods.name: void array_insert_value(array * const a,const char * const v,const uint32_t vlen)

methods.name: array_find_or_insert

methods.name: void array_insert_unique(array * const a,data_unset * const entry)

methods.name: int array_is_kvstring(const array * const a)

methods.name: data_unset * array_match_key_suffix(const array * const a,const buffer * const b)

methods.name: data_unset * array_match_key_suffix_nc(const array * const a,const buffer * const b)
